g.text: The Schema Behind an Index, Not a Query
campaigns and campaign_targeting compile offline into the in-memory index; counters and raw events deliberately live elsewhere
Ad Click Aggregation's raw click log
raw events are consumed asynchronously to update campaign_spend_ledger.spend_amount
-> the Background Indexer compiles these into 3 separate bitmaps, one per (dimension, value) pair
-> a request only ever intersects bitmaps in memory -- it never runs a query against this table
